name: yesornojev
description: Ask a yes/no question about every row of a CSV and watch impossibl JEVs answer it live.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c gray,white "npm run dev -w @yesornojev/server" "npm run dev -w @yesornojev/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @yesornojev/web && npm run build -w @yesornojev/server
